name: pstack
description: if you want to go fast, go deep first. pstack helps you write less, but higher quality code. rigorous agent workflows you can parallelize with confidence.

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous agent workflows: 23 playbooks, 24 engineering principles, parallel subagents.
interface.longDescription: pstack routes each task to a playbook (bug fix, feature, refactor, perf, investigation, shipping, and more), applies engineering principles, delegates to subagents, and verifies every change against the real artifact. Start with $pstack:poteto-mode or $pstack:poteto-help.
defaultPrompt: Use $pstack:poteto-mode to fix this bug with a repro first
Use $pstack:how to explain how this subsystem works
Use $pstack:poteto-help to show me what pstack can do
